ue_15_1.frammento: Applicants for a uniform visa for one or two entries shall prove that they are in possession of adequate and valid travel medical insurance to cover any expenses which might arise in connection with repatriation for medical reasons, urgent medical attention and/or emergency hospital treatment or death, during their stay(s) on the territory of the Member States.

ue_15_2.frammento: Applicants for a multiple-entry visa shall prove that they are in possession of adequate and valid travel medical insurance covering the period of their first intended visit.

ue_15_2_dich.frammento: In addition, such applicants shall sign the statement, set out in the application form, declaring that they are aware of the need to be in possession of travel medical insurance for subsequent stays.

ue_15_3.frammento: The insurance shall be valid throughout the territory of the Member States and cover the entire period of the person’s intended stay or transit.

ue_15_3_minimo.frammento: The minimum coverage shall be EUR 30 000.

ue_15_4.frammento: Applicants shall, in principle, take out insurance in their country of residence. Where this is not possible, they shall seek to obtain insurance in any other country.

ue_15_5.frammento: When assessing whether the insurance cover is adequate, consulates shall ascertain whether claims against the insurance company would be recoverable in a Member State.

ue_commissione.frammento: Medical insurance covering emergency medical care, hospitalisation and repatriation (including in the event of death).
